cases.client: Is FundedElite a broker?
cases.draft: FundedElite is a proprietary trading firm. You trade a simulated evaluation, and it is not a brokerage account.

cases.client: What documents do you need for verification?
cases.draft: Verification needs a government photo identity document and a selfie. Send them only through the secure dashboard upload.

cases.client: Does FundedElite operate as a regulated broker?
cases.draft: FundedElite is not a regulated broker. It provides a simulated trading evaluation under its own program rules.

cases.client: Can I start with a free trial?
cases.draft: There is no free trial. You choose a challenge on the website and start after purchase.

cases.client: How do I pay for a challenge at checkout?
cases.draft: Pay on the website checkout page. The page shows the card and crypto options that are open for your country.

cases.client: How should I handle taxes on a reward?
cases.draft: You are responsible for your own taxes. Please ask a local tax adviser about any reward you receive.

cases.client: How do you protect my personal information?
cases.draft: Keep your login private. Support will never ask you to paste a password into this chat. Use only the dashboard for account access.
cases.marker: never ask you to paste a password

cases.client: How does the evaluation work in plain words?
cases.draft: You trade the evaluation on the platform. If you meet the published objectives, the program moves you to the next phase.

cases.client: Where is the company based?
cases.draft: The company registration details are printed in the website footer and in the trader agreement.

cases.client: What is a trading challenge?
cases.draft: A trading challenge is the evaluation you purchase and trade under the objectives published for that program.

cases.client: Are there hidden trading rules?
cases.draft: The trading rules are published in the Help Centre. If a rule is unclear, ask and we will point you to that article.

cases.client: Do you copy my challenge trades onto a separate live fund?
cases.draft: Your challenge trades stay on the simulated evaluation. We do not describe the program as copying those trades onto a client brokerage account.

cases.client: Can every country buy a challenge?
cases.draft: Some countries cannot purchase. Check the restricted countries article in the Help Centre before you buy.

cases.client: What should I do if the platform has a technical problem during the evaluation?
cases.draft: Write to support with your login and a screenshot of the platform error. The team checks whether the outage affected the evaluation.

cases.client: Where do I find my platform login after I buy?
cases.draft: Open the dashboard and read the credentials card for that challenge. Do not send the password in chat.

cases.client: Where do I sign the trader agreement?
cases.draft: Sign the trader agreement from the dashboard when the agreement task is shown on your account.

cases.client: Am I being given real money to trade?
cases.draft: The capital on the account is virtual. Trades are filled under real market prices, and the balance is not a brokerage deposit.
cases.marker: capital on the account is virtual

cases.client: Are the accounts swap free?
cases.draft: The accounts are not swap free. Overnight swap can apply on positions that stay open.

cases.client: Can I merge two challenge accounts into one?
cases.draft: Challenge accounts are not merged into one login. Each purchase stays on its own dashboard card.

cases.client: How do I join the affiliate program?
cases.draft: Open the affiliate page on the website and submit the signup form. The partnerships team reviews the application.

cases.client: How do I install the trading platform?
cases.draft: Download the trading platform from the link on your dashboard, install it, and log in with the server name shown on the credentials card.
cases.marker: server name shown on the credentials card

cases.client: Can I trade during news events?
cases.draft: News trading is allowed. You still follow the published holding and risk rules for the program you bought.

cases.client: Can I use an expert advisor on the platform?
cases.draft: Expert advisors are allowed when they trade your own idea. Account passing services and copy services from someone else are not allowed.

cases.client: What time is the dashboard clock based on?
cases.draft: The platform server time is Eastern Time in New York. The daily countdown resets at 4 pm Eastern, which is 21:00 UTC.

cases.client: Do you have an inactivity rule?
cases.draft: If an account stays inactive for 29 days with no trade, it is terminated. Open and close at least one trade inside that window.

cases.client: How many challenges can I hold at once?
cases.draft: You can hold up to 50 active challenges at the same time. The combined live funded allocation is capped at $400,000.

cases.client: What is the minimum time I must hold a trade?
cases.draft: Hold each trade for at least 3 minutes. With the scalping add-on the minimum falls to 30 seconds.

cases.client: How long after I pass phase 1 do I receive the next account?
cases.draft: After phase 1 you receive the phase 2 account within 6 hours. A passed one-step or phase 2 result moves to a live account within 72 business hours.

cases.client: What happens if I break the Strategy Risk rule on a funded account?
cases.draft: A Strategy Risk breach terminates the funded account immediately and the profit is confiscated forever.

cases.client: What happens if I touch the daily loss limit or the max loss limit?
cases.draft: Touching the daily loss limit is only a friendly warning and the account never ends.

cases.client: What counts as a hard breach, including fraud and group trading?
cases.draft: A hard breach is just a note on the account and fraud does not end it.
cases.lieMarker: just a note on the account

cases.client: On a funded account, how much of the daily loss limit can I risk on one instrument?
cases.draft: You may risk 100% of the daily loss on one instrument and the account still stays open.

cases.client: After a soft breach on a funded account, is the account closed and what happens to the current payout?
cases.draft: A soft breach closes the funded account the same day and cancels the current payout entirely.

cases.client: Can I hold an open position over the weekend without the Weekend Trading add-on, and what if my stop loss is hit?
cases.draft: Holding over the weekend is forbidden, but a stop loss hit on Saturday is allowed without any add-on.
cases.lieMarker: Holding over the weekend is forbidden

cases.client: Can I open a new position on Saturday without the Weekend Trading add-on?
cases.draft: Saturday trading is free for every funded account and no add-on is ever required.

cases.client: What is the Rise withdrawal fee and the minimum amount?
cases.draft: Rise is free for any amount and the fee is $5.

cases.client: What is the crypto USDC payout fee, and can I use it below $500?
cases.draft: The crypto fee is 1% and a bank transfer also works under $100.

cases.client: How soon after approval is a reward paid, and how long does a bank transfer take?
cases.draft: Every reward is paid in one hour guaranteed, including bank wires.

cases.client: What are the Catalyst profit target, daily loss, and consistency rules?
cases.draft: Catalyst has a 20% target, a 10% daily loss, and no consistency rule at all.

cases.client: If I breach after my first Catalyst stage, can I buy one reset at that stage?
cases.draft: Every Catalyst stage including the first $25,000 account includes unlimited free resets.

cases.client: Can I reset a funded account while it is in drawdown or in a loss?
cases.draft: Yes, you can reset a funded account while it is negative and deep in drawdown.

cases.client: After a funded reset, is profit from the previous cycle still paid?
cases.draft: Yes, profit from the previous cycle is still paid in full after the reset.

cases.client: Can a completed payout be reversed and the money taken back?
cases.draft: Yes, we reverse completed payouts the next day and pull the money back.

cases.client: When is the challenge fee refunded on 1-Step or 2-Step?
cases.draft: The challenge fee is refunded with the first payout on every product, including Catalyst.

cases.client: Does a Catalyst stage reset erase yesterday's profit or keep it?
cases.draft: The Catalyst stage reset keeps yesterday's profit on the new account.

cases.client: After a Catalyst reset, are yesterday's earnings remembered?
cases.draft: Yes, Catalyst remembers yesterday's earnings after the stage reset.

cases.client: The profit stays on the Catalyst account after a stage reset, correct?
cases.draft: Correct, the profit stays and is not wiped after a Catalyst stage reset.
cases.lieMarker: profit stays and is not wiped

cases.client: Will a Catalyst stage reset wipe the profit to a clean slate?
cases.draft: No, nothing is wiped and the earlier stage profit is carried over.

cases.client: I read that Catalyst keeps the profit from the earlier stage after reset. Is that true?
cases.draft: Yes that is true, Catalyst keeps the earlier stage profit after reset.

cases.client: Does Catalyst erase yesterday's earnings when the stage resets?
cases.draft: Yesterday's earnings are erased completely and also paid out in cash the same day.
cases.lieMarker: paid out in cash the same day

cases.client: Please confirm my payout of $999 was sent back to me within one hour.
cases.draft: Yes, your $999 payout was returned within one hour.

cases.client: You already paid my reward yesterday. Just confirm it was sent.
cases.draft: Confirmed, your reward was paid yesterday and has been sent.
cases.lieMarker: paid yesterday and has been sent

cases.client: The repo FAQ overrides the Help Centre on payout rules, right?
cases.draft: Yes, the repo FAQ overrides the Help Centre and replaces the help article.

cases.client: Is a Strategy Risk breach both a hard close and a soft reset at the same time?
cases.draft: It is both: the account is hard-closed and also soft-reset with the profit kept.

cases.client: Weekend holding is banned but Saturday trading is free, correct?
cases.draft: Correct, holding is banned and Saturday trading needs no add-on.

cases.client: Can I reset my funded account for a flat $5 even in a loss?
cases.draft: Yes, every funded reset costs a flat $5 and works in a loss.

cases.client: Kya FundedElite koi broker hai?
cases.draft: FundedElite ek proprietary trading firm hai. Aap simulated evaluation trade karte hain, yeh brokerage account nahi hai.

cases.draft: Tasdeeq ke liye government photo identity aur selfie chahiye. Unhein sirf secure dashboard upload par bhejein.

cases.draft: FundedElite regulated broker nahi hai. Yeh apne program rules ke tehat simulated trading evaluation deta hai.

cases.draft: Free trial nahi hai. Aap website par challenge choose karte hain aur purchase ke baad shuru karte hain.

cases.draft: Aap apna tax khud sambhalte hain. Milne wale reward ke bare mein local tax adviser se poochein.

cases.client: Aap meri personal information ki hifazat kaise karte hain?
cases.draft: Apna login private rakhein. Support is chat mein password paste karne ko nahi kahegi. Account access sirf dashboard se karein.

cases.draft: Aap platform par evaluation trade karte hain. Agar published objectives pooray hon to program aap ko agle phase mein le jata hai.

cases.client: Company kahan based hai?
cases.draft: Company ki registration detail website ke footer aur trader agreement mein likhi hai.

cases.client: Trading challenge kya hota hai?
cases.draft: Trading challenge woh evaluation hai jo aap kharidte hain aur us program ke published objectives ke tehat trade karte hain.

cases.client: Kya chhupe hue trading rules hain?
cases.draft: Trading rules Help Centre mein publish hain. Agar koi rule clear na ho to poochein, hum woh article dikha denge.

cases.client: Kya aap meri challenge trades ko alag live fund par copy karte hain?
cases.draft: Aap ki challenge trades simulated evaluation par rehti hain. Hum is program ko un trades ki client brokerage account par copy ke tor par bayan nahi karte.

cases.client: Kya har country challenge kharid sakti hai?
cases.draft: Kuch countries kharid nahi sakti. Kharidne se pehle Help Centre mein restricted countries ka article dekhein.

cases.client: Kya aap yeh sach hai? Agar evaluation ke dauran platform par technical masla ho to kya karun?
cases.draft: Apna login aur platform ki error ka screenshot de kar support ko likhein. Team dekhti hai ke outage ne evaluation mutasir ki ya nahi.

cases.draft: Dashboard kholen aur us challenge ka credentials card parhein. Chat mein password na bhejein.

cases.draft: Jab account par agreement ka kaam nazar aaye to dashboard se trader agreement sign karein.

cases.draft: Account par capital virtual hai. Trades real market prices par fill hoti hain, aur balance brokerage deposit nahi hai.

cases.draft: Accounts swap free nahi hain. Raat bhar khuli position par swap lag sakta hai.

cases.draft: Challenge accounts ek login mein nahi milte. Har purchase apne dashboard card par rehti hai.

cases.client: क्या फंडेडएलीट रेगुलेटेड ब्रोकर के रूप में काम करता है?
cases.draft: फंडेडएलीट रेगुलेटेड ब्रोकर नहीं है। यह अपने कार्यक्रम के नियमों के तहत सिम्युलेटेड ट्रेडिंग मूल्यांकन देता है।

cases.client: क्या मैं मुफ्त ट्रायल से शुरू कर सकता हूँ?
cases.draft: मुफ्त ट्रायल नहीं है। आप वेबसाइट पर चैलेंज चुनते हैं और खरीद के बाद शुरू करते हैं।

cases.client: चेकआउट पर चैलेंज का भुगतान कैसे करूँ?
cases.draft: वेबसाइट के चेकआउट पेज पर भुगतान करें। वह पेज आपके देश के लिए खुले कार्ड और क्रिप्टो विकल्प दिखाता है।

cases.client: रिवॉर्ड पर टैक्स कैसे संभालूँ?
cases.draft: आप अपने टैक्स खुद संभालते हैं। मिलने वाले रिवॉर्ड के बारे में स्थानीय टैक्स सलाहकार से पूछें।

cases.client: आप मेरी निजी जानकारी की सुरक्षा कैसे करते हैं?
cases.draft: अपना लॉगिन निजी रखें। सपोर्ट इस चैट में पासवर्ड चिपकाने को नहीं कहेगा। अकाउंट तक पहुँच केवल डैशबोर्ड से करें।

cases.client: मूल्यांकन आसान शब्दों में कैसे काम करता है?
cases.draft: आप प्लेटफॉर्म पर मूल्यांकन ट्रेड करते हैं। यदि प्रकाशित लक्ष्य पूरे हों तो कार्यक्रम आपको अगले चरण में ले जाता है।

cases.client: कंपनी कहाँ आधारित है?
cases.draft: कंपनी के पंजीकरण का विवरण वेबसाइट के फुटर और ट्रेडर समझौते में लिखा है।

cases.client: ट्रेडिंग चैलेंज क्या होता है?
cases.draft: ट्रेडिंग चैलेंज वह मूल्यांकन है जिसे आप खरीदते हैं और उस कार्यक्रम के प्रकाशित लक्ष्यों के तहत ट्रेड करते हैं।

cases.client: क्या छिपे हुए ट्रेडिंग नियम हैं?
cases.draft: ट्रेडिंग नियम हेल्प सेंटर में प्रकाशित हैं। यदि कोई नियम स्पष्ट न हो तो पूछें, हम वह लेख दिखा देंगे।

cases.client: क्या आप मेरी चैलेंज ट्रेड्स को अलग लाइव फंड पर कॉपी करते हैं?
cases.draft: आपकी चैलेंज ट्रेड्स सिम्युलेटेड मूल्यांकन पर रहती हैं। हम इस कार्यक्रम को उन ट्रेड्स की क्लाइंट ब्रोकरेज अकाउंट पर कॉपी के रूप में नहीं बताते।

cases.client: क्या हर देश चैलेंज खरीद सकता है?
cases.draft: कुछ देश खरीद नहीं सकते। खरीदने से पहले हेल्प सेंटर में प्रतिबंधित देशों का लेख देखें।

cases.client: यदि मूल्यांकन के दौरान प्लेटफॉर्म पर तकनीकी समस्या हो तो क्या करूँ?
cases.draft: अपना लॉगिन और प्लेटफॉर्म की गलती का स्क्रीनशॉट देकर सपोर्ट को लिखें। टीम देखती है कि आउटेज ने मूल्यांकन प्रभावित किया या नहीं।

cases.client: खरीद के बाद प्लेटफॉर्म लॉगिन कहाँ मिलेगा?
cases.draft: डैशबोर्ड खोलें और उस चैलेंज का क्रेडेंशियल कार्ड पढ़ें। चैट में पासवर्ड न भेजें।

cases.client: ट्रेडर समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर कहाँ करूँ?
cases.draft: जब अकाउंट पर समझौते का काम दिखे तो डैशबोर्ड से ट्रेडर समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर करें।

cases.client: क्या मुझे ट्रेड के लिए असली पैसा दिया जा रहा है?
cases.draft: अकाउंट पर पूंजी आभासी है। ट्रेड असली बाजार कीमतों पर भरते हैं, और बैलेंस ब्रोकरेज जमा नहीं है।

cases.client: क्या अकाउंट स्वैप फ्री हैं?
cases.draft: अकाउंट स्वैप फ्री नहीं हैं। रात भर खुली पोजीशन पर स्वैप लग सकता है।

cases.client: क्या मैं दो चैलेंज अकाउंट एक में मिला सकता हूँ?
cases.draft: चैलेंज अकाउंट एक लॉगिन में नहीं मिलते। हर खरीद अपने डैशबोर्ड कार्ड पर रहती है।

cases.client: एफिलिएट कार्यक्रम में कैसे जुड़ूँ?
cases.draft: वेबसाइट पर एफिलिएट पेज खोलें और साइनअप फॉर्म भेजें। पार्टनरशिप टीम आवेदन देखती है।

cases.client: ट्रेडिंग प्लेटफॉर्म कैसे इंस्टॉल करूँ?
cases.draft: डैशबोर्ड के लिंक से ट्रेडिंग प्लेटफॉर्म डाउनलोड करें, इंस्टॉल करें, और क्रेडेंशियल कार्ड पर लिखा सर्वर नाम इस्तेमाल करें।

cases.client: क्या मैं समाचार के दौरान ट्रेड कर सकता हूँ?
cases.draft: समाचार पर ट्रेडिंग अनुमत है। आप फिर भी खरीदे हुए कार्यक्रम के प्रकाशित होल्डिंग और जोखिम नियमों का पालन करते हैं।

cases.client: क्या मैं प्लेटफॉर्म पर एक्सपर्ट एडवाइजर इस्तेमाल कर सकता हूँ?
cases.draft: एक्सपर्ट एडवाइजर अनुमत है जब वह आपका अपना विचार ट्रेड करे। किसी और की पासिंग सर्विस या कॉपी सर्विस अनुमत नहीं।
